from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Equity attributable to shareholders reported by a single listed company."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the listed company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code of the listed company")
    equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount of equity attributable to shareholders of the listed company at the end of the reporting period")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The date of the financial report (YYYY-MM-DD)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_records: list[CompanyEquityRecord]
